summary: Implementation plan for redesigning the Settings Backup Vault UI (with Default Folder location inspector, copyable path, and file size/health badge), unifying and upgrading the BioSync 6-Pillar Live Telemetry Notification with full-height native XML RemoteViews for razor-sharp text, adding +250 / +500 / +1,000 Step quick-log buttons exclusively to the Home Screen Widget (never in notifications), redesigning the Quick Action Engine UI, and fixing BootReceiver auto-backup rescheduling.
